description: This file defines the PerformanceReview entity class in a Human Resource Management system, mapping to a database table and including properties related to employee performance reviews such as status, review period, dates, comments, ratings, and relationships to other entities like Employee, JobTitle, Subunit, and Reviewer.

classes.name: PerformanceReview
classes.description: Entity class representing a performance review, with properties for review details, status, dates, comments, ratings, and relationships to other HR entities, mapped with Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the performance review.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the performance review.

methods.name: getStatusId
methods.description: Returns the status identifier of the review.

methods.name: setStatusId
methods.description: Sets the status identifier of the review.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodStart
methods.description: Returns the start date of the review period.

methods.name: setReviewPeriodStart
methods.description: Sets the start date for the review period.

methods.name: getReviewPeriodEnd
methods.description: Returns the end date of the review period.

methods.name: setReviewPeriodEnd
methods.description: Sets the end date for the review period.

methods.name: getDueDate
methods.description: Returns the due date for the review.

methods.name: setDueDate
methods.description: Sets the due date for the review.

methods.name: getCompletedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: setCompletedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the review was completed.

methods.name: getActivatedDate
methods.description: Returns the activation date of the review.

methods.name: setActivatedDate
methods.description: Sets the activation date of the review.

methods.name: getFinalComment
methods.description: Gets the final comment associated with the review.

methods.name: setFinalComment
methods.description: Sets the final comment for the review.

methods.name: getFinalRate
methods.description: Returns the final performance rating.

methods.name: setFinalRate
methods.description: Sets the final performance rating.

methods.name: getJobTitle
methods.description: Returns the associated job title for the review.

methods.name: setJobTitle
methods.description: Sets the associated job title for the review.

methods.name: getSubunit
methods.description: Returns the department or subunit related to the review.

methods.name: setSubunit
methods.description: Sets the department or subunit related to the review.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee being reviewed.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee being reviewed.

methods.name: getReviewers
methods.description: Returns the list of reviewers for the performance review.

methods.name: setReviewers
methods.description: Sets the list of reviewers for the performance review.
